build_sphinx_documentation: run the SphinxDocumentation command to generate HTML documentation from the gRPC Python Sphinx source directory
build_project_metadata: run the BuildProjectMetadata command to generate the grpcio version metadata module file
cythonize_extensions: run try_cythonize on a list of distutils Extension objects to generate C source files from Cython
check_cythonization: run check_and_update_cythonization to replace .pyx sources with pre-generated C or C++ counterparts
gather_dependencies: run the Gather command with test or install flags to fetch build eggs for grpcio dependencies
